description: CR 609.3 Lich sacrificing two of three loses alice the game
note: Alice controls a token Lich at 0 life -- not a nontoken permanent, so neither sacrificed nor able to lose her the game by dying -- and two Swamps. Bob's Lightning Bolt deals her 3: she sacrifices both Swamps, as much as possible (CR 609.3), and since she couldn't sacrifice three, she loses. The paired scenario with a third Swamp keeps her in.
